source_behavior.summary: CopyVisibleAsync formats the currently filtered log lines as [Level] Text and writes that text to navigator.clipboard.
source_behavior.success_semantics: copy success is reported only after the browser confirms navigator.clipboard.writeText

laravel_adaptation.filter_semantics: the current logs search input is forwarded as the existing search query, which AdminOperationsController normalizes to q before tenant-scoped persistence read

runtime_path: authenticated user opens the explicit tenant-scoped logs workspace
auth and tenant.context resolve the active membership and the workspace requires operations.manage plus diagnostics.view
the canonical copy control is mounted only in the real logs workspace
the control derives the expected API from authoritative FrontendContext.tenant.slug and rejects a mismatched advertised API
the current search value is sent to the existing GET logs endpoint
AdminOperationsController requires operations.manage and normalizes search to the existing q filter
OperationsControlPlaneService reads operation_logs only where tenant_id equals the active TenantContext id
the returned authoritative rows are formatted using the source [level] message contract
success feedback is rendered only after the clipboard write resolves successfully

authorization.guest: workspace redirects to login and JSON API returns 401

tenant_isolation.foreign_row_proof: focused feature test persists Alpha and Beta logs and proves Alpha search returns only Alpha
tenant_isolation.direct_id_surface: none; the copy operation adds no caller-selected log or tenant resource identifier

security_semantics.csrf: not applicable because the canonical operation performs only authenticated GET reads and a browser-local clipboard write
security_semantics.session: Laravel authenticated session and active tenant membership are required before logs can be read
security_semantics.secrets: no credential/provider secret source is added or exposed; the control copies only the log level and message returned by the already-authorized logs read model
security_semantics.queue_cache_scheduler: none; no job, cache key, lock, retry state, or scheduler state is created or changed
security_semantics.wordpress_connector: none; no WordPress or Connector request is issued
security_semantics.billing_provider: none; no billing or payment provider request is issued despite the canonical billing-domain classification
security_semantics.ai_provider: none; no AI/provider request is issued
security_semantics.persistence: none; the canonical operation does not mutate Laravel or WordPress persistence
security_semantics.idempotency: repeated reads and clipboard writes create no server-side state and are safely repeatable
security_semantics.truthful_empty: an empty authoritative result reports no visible results and never reports copy success
security_semantics.truthful_failure: API, capability, permission, tenant-contract, or clipboard failure cannot produce copy success

assertions: exact canonical operation marker and source formatting contract
trusted same-tenant logs API and current search request
clipboard success only after resolved write
foreign advertised tenant endpoint and missing permission disable the control
persisted cross-tenant log rows do not leak into the active tenant read

terminality.reason: The source-faithful Copy results control is visibly mounted on the real tenant logs workspace, reads only the trusted active-tenant logs API under existing auth/RBAC/TenantContext enforcement, preserves the current search semantics, copies only authoritative [level] message rows, and reports success only after a confirmed browser clipboard write.
